December 23, 2025 - Penzler now heads Penzler Publishers and its imprints The Mysterious Press, Crime Ink, and American Mystery Classics. He also continues to publish both original works and classic crime fiction through MysteriousPress.com, in partnership with Open Road Integrated Media.

April 24, 2024 - Mysterious Press was founded in 1975 by Otto Penzler, and was one of the first genre publishers to use materials such as acid-free paper, full-cloth bindings, and full-color dust jackets. Many of the books it published were done in both trade and limited editions. In 1989, the company was sold to Warner Books, which was bought by Hachette in 2005.
